title: Surface verdict instructions field never exposed to callers
wanted_capability: Per-surface instructions (human-readable guidance) surfaced through MCP ServerInfo or similar so callers see the surface's declared intent
notes: ToolSurfaceVerdict::ToolSurface carries an `instructions: Option<String>` field. The routing packet supports it, the evaluator preserves it, and the system-defaults packet defines instructions for each surface (e.g. readonly: "Read-only surface for reviewers..."). But the field is never read by any code path — the handler's initialize/surface_entry don't inject it into ServerInfo.instructions, and no consumer can access it. The open question from design/surfaces/mcp/mcp-surfaces.md ("Should surface decisions include instructions, and if so where can RMCP expose per-surface instructions cleanly?") was never resolved.
